audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[5].side and phases[6].side both read 'Skill' while content win[5] says Zed and win[6] says Cassiopeia, and the packet chart agrees with the content layer. The page rendered two different answers for First item and 2+ items.
audit.why: First item is Zed's window — Cassiopeia has no dash and Twin Fang's heal cannot outpace a full mark string. Two items in, Miasma's grounding (24/22/20/18/16s) plus a 0.75s Twin Fang inverts it.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side to Zed, phases[6].side to Cassiopeia with rating 4/10, both whys rewritten to match. win[5] and win[6] already read correctly, so no content-layer chart edits are proposed.

audit.why: Level 3, level 6 (Death Mark 120/110/100s) and first item are Zed's; Cassiopeia's spike is resistances plus Twin Fang uptime at full build. The existing four spikes describe exactly that curve.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Miasma 'grounds you' but never gives its cooldown, never says that grounding kills BOTH of Zed's dash tools (Living Shadow's swap and Death Mark's dash), and never mentions Twin Fang's 0.75s cooldown or its heal — which is the whole reason chip damage does not stick.
audit.why: Zed's W and R both carry the dash flag; Miasma carries grounding, which disables movement abilities. Twin Fang is a 0.75s, 40-mana projectile that heals for a share of damage dealt and does bonus damage to poisoned targets. Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her and slows those with their back turned.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and the trade lines now state Miasma's 24s/16s, the double dash denial, and Twin Fang's heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags anti-heal as needed and report[8] said 'his sustain' for a female champion.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia for a percentage of damage dealt on a 0.75s cooldown, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: report[8] pronoun corrected; the anti-heal instruction it already carried now reads correctly.
